meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: 它把多步任务拆成有依赖关系的节点图,在 eval 单元里定义并运行:节点按依赖分批并行执行,可看每个节点的进度与失败。单个节点出错可用 retry、send 或 amend 恢复,已完成节点的结果会被复用。
howto.when: 当你提到 mass-ulw、任务 DAG,或要求存在先后依赖的分批工作时触发;完全独立的并行任务则不需要它。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这次改动拆成有依赖的任务图
say.note: 先读规划文档,再定义节点

say.text: 给评审节点加 dependsOn,让它等审计节点跑完再开始
重跑那个失败的节点,顺手把它的指令改一下
say.note: 只重试该节点,已完成的结果复用

howto.what_en: It turns multi-step requests into a dependency-ordered node graph and runs it in an eval cell: nodes run in parallel waves as dependencies clear. A failed node can be retried or amended; finished nodes keep their results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others; fully independent parallel work does not need it.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to turn this change into a dependency-ordered task graph.
say_en.note: It reads planning.md first, then defines the nodes.

say_en.text: Add dependsOn to the review node so it waits for the audit node.
say_en.note: Nodes run in parallel waves as dependencies clear.

say_en.text: Retry the failed node and edit its prompt.
say_en.note: Completed nodes keep their cached results.
